card.name: Linking words before cephalosporin class
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, and, other, a) right before the word cephalosporin(s) in beta-lactam allergy or contraindication statements. It also fires inside some cef-type drug names.

modes.label: Before cephalosporins
modes.description: A linking word such as 'and', 'the' or 'other' comes just before 'cephalosporin' in a list of beta-lactam allergies.
modes.example: to other beta-lactam antibacterial drugs (e.g., penicillins<< and>> cephalosporins). Ampic

modes.label: Inside drug name
modes.description: Partway through a drug name that is built like a cephalosporin or beta-lactam name.
modes.example: Admixtures with Other Antibiotics Intravenous infusion solutions of AZ<<ACT>>AM not exceeding 2% w/v

card.writes: It pushes the model toward continuing with cep- (as in cephalosporin) or ce- word beginnings.
card.plain: It spots the spot where the text is about to name cephalosporins in an allergy warning.
